statements.notes: Whole-O2 AUDIT PASS. Local absolute continuity uses the standard L1 a.e.-derivative plus integral-representation characterization on every compact positive interval, independent of Pearson and normalization; no unavailable native AC predicate equivalence is claimed. Continuity and the everywhere Pearson derivative are derived, not assumed. Positivity is not required by the uniqueness proof, which is stronger than the paper; canonical positivity is supplied separately. Nonzero mass derives integrability, and the actual positive-supported measure is proved equal. The initial raw-flux differentiability caution is resolved by HasLocalACPearsonFlux: arbitrary a.e. coefficient representatives may have discontinuous raw aw, but an independent locally AC representative F with F=aw a.e. is used instead. After coefficient recovery, continuity upgrades F=tw from a.e. to pointwise, allowing legitimate derivative transport. This is an expression/weight theorem only, not a claim about the separate unbounded Hilbert operator or its domain.
